# Crimealysis

> Crimealysis provides threat intelligence for cryptocurrency/blockchain analytics companies, mobile network operators, and law enforcement agencies, focused on dark web and smishing threats.

Crimealysis helps organisations detect, investigate, and disrupt cybercrime by turning dark web and smishing signals into actionable, evidence-ready intelligence. The company is registered in the United Kingdom (Companies House No. 15724545) and operates as a fully remote team.

## Company

- [Home](https://crimealysis.com/index.html): Overview of Crimealysis's threat intelligence solutions for crypto/blockchain analytics companies, mobile network operators, and law enforcement.
- [Careers](https://crimealysis.com/careers.html): Information about working at Crimealysis, including our fully remote workplace policy.
